title: Dephosphorylation of epitopes in murine skin sections
protocol: Deparaffinize the tissue sections by submerging them in xylol for 5 minutes.
Submerge the sections in fresh xylol for 5 minutes.
Transfer the sections to isopropanol and incubate for 5 minutes.
Incubate the sections in 96% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Incubate the sections in 75% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Incubate the sections in 50% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Wash the sections with water for 5 minutes.
Retrieve epitopes by boiling the sections in Dako Antigen Retrieval Agent pH9 for 20 minutes inside a boiling cuvette in a pressure cooker.
Allow the slides to cool down within the retrieval solution for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash the sections twice with PBS++.
Delimit the tissue sections with a fat pen (Dako pen).
Incubate the tissue sections with 25U Antarctic Phosphatase in AP buffer for 2 hours at 37°C in a humidified chamber.
Alternatively, incubate the tissue sections with AP buffer only as a vehicle control for 2 hours at 37°C in a humidified chamber.
Block unspecific binding sites with 5% BSA in PBS++ for 1 hour at room temperature in a humidified chamber.
Ensure that the blocking solution covers the entire tissue section.
